name: State Comparison
description: Questions comparing two states on the same metric to highlight inequality

questions.question: Compare education spending between Lagos and Zamfara in 2024. What is the per-student spending in each state?
Compare healthcare budget between Rivers State and Borno State in 2024. How much does each state spend per citizen on health?
Compare infrastructure spending between Kano and Ebonyi in 2024. How many kilometers of road could each state build with their budget?
Compare total budget size between Delta State and Osun State in 2024. Which state gets more per citizen?
Compare water resources spending between Bayelsa and Kaduna in 2024. How many boreholes could each state fund?
Compare agriculture budget between Kebbi and Enugu in 2024. Which state invests more in food security for its people?
